components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A high-contrast action for exploring work or contacting Sanskriti.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--signal); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--signal); color: var(--paper); font: 700 .92rem/1.35 'Work Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-action:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #c1ee8f; color: var(--paper); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Map Node
components.description: A selectable route to a real portfolio section.
components.css: .ds-map-node { display: flex; min-height: 64px; flex-direction: column; gap: .35rem; padding: .45rem .75rem; color: #edf1e9; text-align: left; text-decoration: none; } .ds-map-topic { color: #edf1e9; font: 600 1.2rem/1.1 'Alegreya', Georgia, serif; } .ds-map-detail { color: #c2cdc4; font: 400 .78rem/1.4 'Work Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-map-node:hover .ds-map-topic, .ds-map-node:focus-visible .ds-map-topic { color: #a8d977; } .ds-map-node:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a8d977; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a graphite investigation console framing warm evidence plates. It blends Linux terminal cues, forensic case files, and a neural-network-inspired map, while keeping the interface grounded in real projects, experience, and writing.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces and signal-green focus points.
Warm paper plates for project evidence and dissertation imagery.
Direct paths from work themes to real portfolio sections.
Monospace reserved for compact metadata and labels.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Color distinguishes navigation, context, and source material; it never substitutes for the evidence itself.

dos: Do connect every map node to real project, experience, or writing evidence.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and retain the reduced-motion alternative.
Do preserve factual claims, image credits, and useful image descriptions.
donts: Don't present the evidence map as a model architecture.
Don't invent terminal output, system status, testimonials, or performance claims.
Don't use monospace for long-form copy or add motion that competes with the work.
